artworks.title: Menelaus and Hector Fighting over the Body of Euphorbus
artworks.description: The name-vase Euphorbos plate in the British Museum (GR 1860,0404.1): Menelaus and Hector fight over the fallen Trojan while labels in the archaic alphabet name the dead man ΕΥΦΟΡΒΟΣ. One of the earliest labelled Homeric scenes in Greek art — Panthous' son who wounded Patroclus before Hector finished the kill.
